title: Proposed Watchlist for Companies that Discriminate Based on Attributes Like Gender and Ethnicity
what_it_is: Proposed Watchlist for Companies that Discriminate Based on Attributes Like Gender and Ethnicity

sections.label: MOM action on discrimination
sections.summary: MOM debars employers for substantiated gender or ethnicity discrimination, and watchlists and scrutinises nationality bias cases before possible debarment.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Some forms of discrimination, including those related to gender and ethnicity, are more readily substantiated by specific actions, such as verbal utterances or written job advertisements.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: In cases involving such discrimination and substantiated through investigations, MOM can and has debarred the errant employers from making Work Pass applications, without first putting them on a watchlist.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: For cases where discrimination involves nationality bias, which is less readily apparent, MOM puts the employers on a watchlist and scrutinises their Work Pass applications for irregularities.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: We may subsequently debar them if they fail to cooperate to improve their human resource practices.

sections.label: TAFEP reports and MOM sanctions
sections.summary: TAFEP reports guideline breaches like gender or ethnicity discrimination to MOM, which can warn or curtail Work Pass privileges; workers should report to TAFEP or MOM.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: Where guidelines are breached, such as where there is discrimination on the basis of gender or ethnicity, TAFEP will then report such cases to MOM, and MOM will then impose sanctions, which can be issuing stern warnings, or even curtailing the Work Pass privileges of the employer.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: And that has a direct impact on the employers.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: So, where it comes to any feedback on workplace discrimination and it is mentioned about gender or ethnicity, I have explained earlier that perhaps because it is a bit more readily apparent, in fact, we do not even need to wait for a watchlist.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: TAFEP will report to MOM, and we can curtail the Work Pass privileges of the employers.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: But having said that, I would want to reassure the Member that MOM works very closely with TAFEP, employers and also human resource practitioners to build inclusive workplaces and to eradicate any form of work discrimination.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: And we urge workers who face any such occurrences, whether it is gender, ethnicity or even nationality bias, to please promptly report the matter to TAFEP or MOM.
